name: Intra Balance Query Criteria 10
definition: Defines the criteria based on which information is included.

CancellationRequestIdentification.name: Cancellation Request Identification
CancellationRequestIdentification.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

ProcessingStatus.name: Processing Status
ProcessingStatus.definition: Provides the status of settlement of a transaction.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account in which cash is maintained.

CashAccountServicer.name: Cash Account Servicer
CashAccountServicer.definition: Party that manages the cash account on behalf of the account owner, that is manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

MessageOriginator.name: Message Originator
MessageOriginator.definition: Party that originated the message, if other than the sender.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Specifies the creation date/time of the intra-balance movement.
